hook: The $19.99 piece that keeps my garage organized

scenes.visual_prompt: Keys dropped on the hood of a car, mail piled on a nearby counter
scenes.voiceover: Every day, same spot — the hood of my car.

scenes.visual_prompt: Time-lapse of the pile of mail and keys growing over a week
scenes.on_screen_text: This is how the whole system backslides.
scenes.voiceover: Organize the shelves, ignore the door, and it's chaos again in a month.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mounting a wall key holder with 6 hooks and a small shelf next to the garage door
scenes.voiceover: 4.8 stars across 4,169 reviews, hardware sturdy enough for daily use.

scenes.visual_prompt: Hanging keys on the hooks and setting mail on the small shelf
scenes.on_screen_text: One home for keys. Every time.
scenes.voiceover: The daily walk-through becomes the moment you put things away.

scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot a month later — the key holder is still neatly used, no pileup on the counter
scenes.voiceover: This $20 piece is why the rest of the system holds.

scenes.visual_prompt: Text card with the full garage wall system visible behind it
scenes.on_screen_text: Full $91 garage wall build on the blog.

caption: This $19.99 key holder is the smallest line item in my $91 garage wall system — and the reason the rest of it stayed organized. Blog has the full build.
